connectorUiConfig.title: RedRays SAP Security Findings
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Bring RedRays SAP security findings into Microsoft Sentinel. Review vulnerability assessments, ABAP code findings, BTP security, segregation of duties, profile parameter checks and password security in one workbook, with analytics rules for findings that need attention. RedRays sends data on a schedule you choose through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and stays in your existing on-premises or cloud environment. This connector does not collect SAP Security Audit Log events or populate ABAPAuditLog. You need a RedRays license with Microsoft Sentinel integration. Azure ingestion and retention charges apply.

sampleQueries.description: Latest export status by RedRays instance
sampleQueries.query: RedRaysExportHealth_CL | where RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT' | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ProductInstanceId

value: RedRaysExportHealth_CL | where RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT' | summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) | project IsConnected=LastSeen > ago(2d)

instructionSteps.description: Start with a Log Analytics workspace that has Microsoft Sentinel enabled in Azure public cloud. Create a dedicated Microsoft Entra application and client secret, or use an approved existing service principal. Keep the tenant ID, application (client) ID and service principal object ID handy. For the role assignment, use the service principal object ID from Enterprise applications; the application object ID and client ID are different values.
instructionSteps.title: 1. Prepare your workspace and application

instructionSteps.description: In RedRays, open Platform Settings > Microsoft Sentinel and download the deployment template. In Azure, open Deploy a custom template > Build your own template in the editor and upload it. Select your workspace's resource group and region, then enter workspaceName and senderPrincipalId. Leave deployAnalyticsRules=false; you will create rules from the Content Hub templates later. The deployment creates eight Analytics tables, a DCR for direct ingestion and a Monitoring Metrics Publisher role assignment scoped to that DCR. Copy ingestionEndpoint and dcrImmutableId from the deployment outputs. You can also use Deployment/azuredeploy.json from the source bundle. Check that your RedRays version uses the same eight table schemas as this solution, and give the DCR a dedicated name so it does not replace another integration's configuration.
instructionSteps.title: 2. Deploy ingestion resources

instructionSteps.description: Enter tenant ID, client ID, client secret, ingestion endpoint and DCR immutable ID in RedRays. Choose the modules to export and how often to send data. Keep baseline alerting disabled for the first import, then save and enable the integration. RedRays needs outbound HTTPS access to Microsoft Entra and the Azure Monitor ingestion endpoint. No inbound connection is required.
instructionSteps.title: 3. Configure RedRays

instructionSteps.description: Send a test event from RedRays, then wait for a scheduled export. Query RedRaysExportHealth_CL for RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT'. A successful test means Azure accepted the request; the record may take time to appear in queries. The connector shows Connected when it has received a heartbeat in the past two days. Use the export health rule and workbook to monitor delays against your export schedule.
instructionSteps.title: 4. Verify delivery

instructionSteps.description: Open Manage solution to create the workbook and selected analytics rules from templates. Review the initial findings before enabling rules. Most finding rules alert on actionable High or Critical candidates. The profile rule raises Medium severity alerts for VULNERABLE checks. The export health rule defaults to 60 minutes; set this above your export interval, allowing time for ingestion. Disable equivalent rules from earlier RedRays deployments to avoid duplicate alerts. Delivery retries can still produce duplicate incidents, and finding updates do not automatically close incidents. For help, contact support@redrays.io.
instructionSteps.title: 5. Enable security content

properties.description: RedRays01_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.2

Alerts on new or materially changed, actionable SAP vulnerabilities from RedRays. Only High or Critical findings are selected. Initial findings raise alerts only if you enable baseline alerting in RedRays. Records outside the one-day query window do not trigger this rule.
properties.query:
// Map each ProductInstanceId to its RedRays origin to resolve relative source links.
// Example: dynamic({"<ProductInstanceId>": "https://redrays.example"})
let redRaysPortalUrls = dynamic({});
let observations = RedRaysVulnerabilities_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)
| extend ArrivedAt = ingestion_time()
| summarize arg_min(ArrivedAt, *) by EventId;
let candidates = observations
| where IsAlertCandidate == true and ArrivedAt > ago(15m)
| project FindingKey, AlertFingerprint, AlertEventId = EventId, AlertArrivedAt = ArrivedAt
| summarize arg_min(AlertArrivedAt, *) by FindingKey, AlertFingerprint;
observations
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by FindingKey
| where IsActionable == true
| where SourceSeverity in ("HIGH", "CRITICAL")
| join kind=inner candidates on FindingKey, AlertFingerprint
| extend EventId = AlertEventId
| extend EntityHost = trim_end(@"\.", trim(@"\s+", tostring(Host)))
| extend EntityIP = iff(EntityHost !contains "/" and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(EntityHost)), EntityHost, "")
| extend EntityHost = iff(isempty(EntityIP) and strlen(EntityHost) <= 253
    and EntityHost matches regex @"(?i)^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(?:\.[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*$"
    and not(EntityHost matches regex @"^[0-9.]+$"), tolower(EntityHost), "")
| extend _portalOrigin = tostring(redRaysPortalUrls[tostring(ProductInstanceId)]), _sourceLink = tostring(SourceUrl)
| extend _entityUrlCandidate = case(
    _sourceLink startswith "/app/" and _portalOrigin matches regex @"(?i)^https?://[^/?#@\s\\]+/?$",
    strcat(trim_end(@"/+", _portalOrigin), _sourceLink),
    _sourceLink)
| extend _parsedEntityUrl = parse_url(_entityUrlCandidate)
| extend EntityUrl = iff(tostring(_parsedEntityUrl.Scheme) in~ ("https", "http")
    and isnotempty(tostring(_parsedEntityUrl.Host))
    and isempty(tostring(_parsedEntityUrl.Username)) and isempty(tostring(_parsedEntityUrl.Password))
    and not(_entityUrlCandidate matches regex @"[\s\\]"), _entityUrlCandidate, "")
| project-away _portalOrigin, _sourceLink, _entityUrlCandidate, _parsedEntityUrl

properties.description: RedRays SAP Security Findings Analytics Rule 6
RedRays07_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.2

Alerts when a previously connected RedRays instance stops sending export heartbeats. Set the threshold above your export interval and expected ingestion delay. The rule needs a previous heartbeat within its one-day query window.
properties.query:
// Set above the export interval and ingestion delay. Requires a heartbeat in the lookback.
let maxHeartbeatAge = 60m;
RedRaysExportHealth_CL
| where RecordKind == 'HEARTBEAT'
| summarize LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by ProductInstanceId
| where LastSeen < ago(maxHeartbeatAge)
| extend TimeGenerated=LastSeen

Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

Bring RedRays SAP security findings into Microsoft Sentinel. Review vulnerability assessments, ABAP code findings, BTP security, segregation of duties, profile parameter checks and password security in one workbook, with analytics rules for findings that need attention. RedRays sends data on a schedule you choose through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and stays in your existing on-premises or cloud environment. This connector does not collect SAP Security Audit Log events or populate ABAPAuditLog. You need a RedRays license with Microsoft Sentinel integration. Azure ingestion and retention charges apply.

Data Connectors: 1, Workbooks: 1, Analytic Rules: 7
